newsitem.title: UGANDA: Zairean rebels take eastern town - refugees.
newsitem.headline: Zairean rebels take eastern town - refugees.

text.p: Zairean rebels captured the eastern Zairean town of Bunia, forcing looting and rampaging Zairean soldiers to flee northwards, Ugandan military sources and refugees arriving in this border town said on Tuesday.
The military sources said Bunia fell on Monday night after heavy fighting and Zairean rebels were on Tuesday clearing a few pockets of resistance.
"Bunia has fallen to the Zairean rebels. That is our understanding of the situation there," a Ugandan military source said.

Zairean refugees among some 3,000 refugees who arrived in Kasese after fleeing the latest fighting said Zairean soldiers looted Bunia, beat up residents and raped many women before the town fell into rebels hands on Monday night.
"The Banyamulenge (rebels) have taken over Bunia. Zairean soldiers have fled from the area and we do not known where they have gone," a refugee who arrived in Kasese on Tuesday said.
"We chose to come to Uganda because Zairean soldiers are looting and raping as they flee the Banyamulenge," she added
Africa's latest conflict was ignited by Zairean attempts to expel the Banyamulenge -- an ethnic Tutsi group which came to Zaire from Rwanda up to 200 years ago.
